results: Requirement N29 fully implemented and verified: web health separated from engine, authoritative storage, and required provider readiness.

Real engine readiness evaluated across authoritative storage (adapter write, manifest integrity, disk space) and required providers (local_opa, self_hosted_keycloak, owned_synthetic_upstream); component outages return visible HTTP 503 errors and structured reason codes without placeholder success.
Diagnostics telemetry ring buffer implemented in internal/gateway/diagnostics.go bounded to 100 entries and max 4096 bytes per message, preventing log/memory bloat.
Credential and token scrubber implemented across engine and web supervisor, strictly redacting Bearer tokens, JWTs, sensitive session cookies, passwords, and synthetic test sentinels (*_SENTINEL).
Private diagnostic endpoints enforce fail-closed authorization rejecting unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401.
Operational guide ops/diagnostics.md created documenting liveness vs readiness separation, runbook troubleshooting, and sentinel redaction policies.
Web server readiness in scripts/serve-web.mjs enhanced to proxy /api/v1/runtime/readiness and /api/v1/runtime/diagnostics and support deep engine inspection.
Dedicated test suite tests/web/engine-readiness.test.mjs and Go integration test tests/readiness_test.go pass all assertions.
Ten Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures cataloged with SHA-256 digests in tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C29/manifest.json.
